searchText: there's no such thing as a compressed signature (at least, compressed to any significant extent) if you want signatures smaller than two field elements (~64 bytes), you need to go to BLS which incidentally lets you do really awesome things like https://ethresear.ch/t/adding-cross-transaction-bls-signature-aggregation-to-ethereum/7844 The price is one pairing verification per transaction, which is much more expensive than an EC sig **EIP-1559 Implementers' Call in ~1h (15:00 UTC)** **Agenda:** https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/209 **Zoom: **https://consensys.zoom.us/j/97327416644
